meaning.en: A person so thick-skinned and stubborn that nothing can touch or persuade them.
meaning.zh: 指软硬不吃、耍赖难缠的人。

examples.zh: 这个滚刀肉，怎么说他都不听。
examples.en: That impossible character won't listen however you put it.

examples.zh: 别跟滚刀肉讲道理，他根本不在乎。
examples.en: Don't reason with a shameless hard case; he just doesn't care.

usage.en: Northern colloquial, from the image of meat so tough the knife rolls off it. Derogatory.
usage.zh: 北方口语，像一块刀砍不进的肉。含贬义。

meaning.en: To take a quicker route, often skipping necessary effort.
meaning.zh: 走近路；常指为省事而不循常规。

examples.zh: 学习想走捷径是行不通的，只能一步一个脚印。
examples.en: Trying to take shortcuts in learning doesn't work; you must go one step at a time.

examples.zh: 为了赶工期，工人走了捷径，结果出了质量问题。
examples.en: To meet the deadline, workers took shortcuts and ended up with quality problems.

usage.en: Literal (a shorter path) or figurative; the figurative sense often warns against corner-cutting.
usage.zh: 可指走近路，也可比喻不循正途，多含警示。

meaning.en: To play the stern or villainous role while a partner plays the nice one.
meaning.zh: 在合作中扮演严厉、不讨好的角色。

examples.zh: 我来唱白脸，你负责安抚客户。
examples.en: I'll be the bad cop; you calm the client.

examples.zh: 他在家总是唱白脸，孩子都有点怕他。
examples.en: He always plays the bad cop at home, and the kids are a bit scared of him.

usage.en: From opera: a white-painted face marks a treacherous or cunning character. Pairs with 唱红脸.
usage.zh: 源自戏曲：白脸代表奸诈角色。常与“唱红脸”对举。

meaning.en: To look for small faults, often unfairly.
meaning.zh: 故意找小缺点，鸡蛋里挑骨头。

examples.zh: 他总爱挑别人的毛病，自己却不反省。
examples.en: He always picks on others' faults but never reflects on his own.

examples.zh: 婆婆专爱挑毛病，让儿媳很为难。
examples.en: The mother-in-law loves finding fault, which puts her daughter-in-law in a difficult position.

usage.en: Usually critical. Splits: 挑他的毛病.
usage.zh: 多含批评，可拆开用。

meaning.en: To be sacrificed for others' purposes; to be used and discarded.
meaning.zh: 被人当作牺牲品利用，毫无价值地被消耗。

examples.zh: 新人刚入职就被派去当炮灰，没人替他说话。
examples.en: The newcomer was sent in as cannon fodder, and nobody spoke up for him.

examples.zh: 我可不想为他们当炮灰。
examples.en: I don't want to be cannon fodder for them.

usage.en: Noun 炮灰 is soldiers killed as fodder; extended to anyone sacrificed in a power struggle.
usage.zh: “炮灰”本指战场上被牺牲的士兵，后泛指被利用牺牲的人。

meaning.en: To take an extreme position or action, losing sense of proportion.
meaning.zh: 采取过激的态度或做法。

examples.zh: 遇到分歧不要走极端，大家坐下来谈。
examples.en: When you disagree, don't go to extremes; sit down and talk.

examples.zh: 他一生气就走极端，什么事都做得出来。
examples.en: He goes to extremes when angry and is capable of anything.

usage.en: Critical. 极端 is jí duān.
usage.zh: 含批评，多用于劝说。

meaning.en: A polite but firm refusal that leaves no room to continue.
meaning.zh: 委婉而坚决的拒绝。

examples.zh: 他想借钱，却碰了个软钉子。
examples.en: He tried to borrow money and got a polite brush-off.

examples.zh: 对方给了我们一个软钉子，让我们知难而退。
examples.en: They gave us a tactful rebuff to make us back down.

usage.en: Usually 碰软钉子 (receive) or 给软钉子 (give). Contrasts with 硬钉子 (outright refusal).
usage.zh: 常说“碰软钉子”。对应“硬钉子”（强硬拒绝）。

meaning.en: One's hidden calculations, often selfish ones.
meaning.zh: 心里暗暗的盘算，多指为自己打算。

examples.zh: 他心里有自己的小九九，没人猜得透。
examples.en: He has his own private agenda that nobody can guess.

examples.zh: 你那点小九九，我早看出来了。
examples.en: I saw through your little scheme ages ago.

usage.en: From 九九乘法表 (multiplication table): reckoning in one's head. Often 打小九九.
usage.zh: 来自九九乘法口诀，指心里盘算。常说“打小九九”。

meaning.en: To talk in an official tone to brush someone off or avoid taking responsibility.
meaning.zh: 用官场套话敷衍人、推卸责任。

examples.zh: 窗口人员一直打官腔，没解决任何问题。
examples.en: The counter staff kept to officialese and solved nothing.

examples.zh: 他当了领导后，一开口就打官腔。
examples.en: Since becoming a leader, he talks in officialese the moment he opens his mouth.

usage.en: Derogatory; 腔 is qiāng. Targets bureaucratic evasiveness.
usage.zh: 含贬义，“腔”读qiāng。

meaning.en: To guarantee that something will turn out as promised.
meaning.zh: 出面保证事情一定办成或没问题。

examples.zh: 这批货的质量，我可以打包票。
examples.en: I can guarantee the quality of this shipment.

examples.zh: 谁也不敢打包票说明年一定盈利。
examples.en: No one dares guarantee profit next year.

usage.en: Often in negatives (不敢打包票). 包票 means a written guarantee.
usage.zh: 常用否定式“不敢打包票”。“包票”指保证书。

meaning.en: To compete directly with a rival, as in a martial-arts arena challenge.
meaning.zh: 比喻双方直接较量、争个高低。

examples.zh: 两家公司在同一市场上打擂台。
examples.en: The two firms go head to head in the same market.

examples.zh: 两位歌手打起擂台，粉丝们都很兴奋。
examples.en: The two singers are squaring off, and the fans are excited.

usage.en: 擂台 is the raised ring in a martial-arts contest. Often 唱对台戏 for pointed rivalry.
usage.zh: “擂台”指比武的高台。

meaning.en: To meet face to face, especially by chance.
meaning.zh: 碰面，当面遇上。

examples.zh: 我们在楼道里打了个照面，互相点点头。
examples.en: We ran into each other in the corridor and nodded.

examples.zh: 他们两个从来没打过照面。
examples.en: The two of them have never met face to face.

usage.en: Usually 打个照面 for a brief meeting.
usage.zh: 多说“打个照面”，指匆匆见一面。

meaning.en: To lose one's temper and act willfully in order to show displeasure.
meaning.zh: 故意发脾气，任性闹情绪。

examples.zh: 孩子买不到玩具，在商场里耍起了脾气。
examples.en: The child threw a tantrum in the mall for not getting the toy.

examples.zh: 你别在我面前耍脾气，我可不惯着你。
examples.en: Don't throw tantrums at me; I won't indulge you.

usage.en: Often to adults or children behaving childishly. Splits: 耍起了脾气.
usage.zh: 用于任性发火的人，可拆开用。

meaning.en: To whisper privately; also to talk secretly or gossip.
meaning.zh: 凑近耳边小声说话，指私下交谈。

examples.zh: 开会时他俩总在底下咬耳朵。
examples.en: The two of them are always whispering to each other during meetings.

examples.zh: 领导跟我咬了咬耳朵，让我先别声张。
examples.en: The boss had a quiet word, telling me not to say anything yet.

usage.en: Casual; literally 'bite ear'. Sometimes 交头接耳 in written style.
usage.zh: 口语，书面语常用“交头接耳”。

meaning.en: To drag someone into wrongdoing or trouble.
meaning.zh: 引诱别人一起做坏事或陷入麻烦。

examples.zh: 他自己犯了错，还想把朋友拉下水。
examples.en: He made a mistake himself and now wants to drag his friend down too.

examples.zh: 别被坏人拉下水，做人要有底线。
examples.en: Don't be dragged in by bad people; keep your principles.

usage.en: Usually 被拉下水 (be dragged in). Derogatory toward the person who drags.
usage.zh: 常用“被拉下水”，对拉人者含贬义。

meaning.en: Something that looks impressive but has no substance.
meaning.zh: 外表像样、实际没有内容或实力。

examples.zh: 这家公司只是个空架子，根本没有业务。
examples.en: The company is just an empty shell with no business.

examples.zh: 别摆空架子，拿出真本事来。
examples.en: Stop putting on a show and show real ability.

usage.en: Often 摆空架子. Contrasts with 真功夫.
usage.zh: 常说“摆空架子”。

meaning.en: To give someone special attention or extra help; originally, to cook a separate, better meal for a few people.
meaning.zh: 给予特别照顾或额外辅导；本指另做好饭菜给少数人吃。

examples.zh: 老师晚上给我开小灶，帮我补数学。
examples.en: The teacher gave me extra tuition in the evening to catch up on maths.

examples.zh: 他在公司吃小灶，待遇比别人好。
examples.en: He gets special treatment at work, better than the others.

usage.en: In canteens, 大灶 fed the masses; 小灶 fed senior staff. Can be neutral praise or envy.
usage.zh: 旧时食堂分大灶、中灶、小灶，小灶待遇最好。可羡慕可中性。

meaning.en: To get angry; in Chinese medicine anger flares the liver.
meaning.zh: 发怒；中医认为生气会引起肝火上升。

examples.zh: 有话好好说，别动肝火。
examples.en: Say it nicely; don't fly into a temper.

examples.zh: 医生劝他少动肝火，对身体好。
examples.en: The doctor advised him to stay calm for his health.

usage.en: Often as advice: 别动肝火. Also 肝火旺 (quick-tempered).
usage.zh: 常用于劝告“别动肝火”。

meaning.en: Someone who leaves all the work and responsibility to others.
meaning.zh: 指把事情全交给别人、自己不管事的人。

equivalents: someone who leaves it all to others

examples.zh: 他当了老板就做甩手掌柜，什么事都不过问。
examples.en: He turned into a hands-off boss and asks about nothing.

examples.zh: 在家带孩子，他一直是甩手掌柜。
examples.en: When it comes to the kids at home, he leaves everything to others.

usage.en: Often critical of absent spouses or managers. 柜 is guì.
usage.zh: 常批评不管事的丈夫或管理者。

meaning.en: A person with no firm stand who goes with whoever is strongest.
meaning.zh: 比喻没有主见、随风倒的人。

equivalents: one who sways with the wind

examples.zh: 他是墙头草，哪边得势就倒向哪边。
examples.en: He's a fence-sitter who sides with whoever is winning.

examples.zh: 别做墙头草，要有自己的立场。
examples.en: Don't be a weathervane; have your own stance.

usage.en: Often the full saying 墙头草，随风倒. Derogatory.
usage.zh: 常说全句“墙头草，随风倒”。含贬义。

meaning.en: To keep all the benefits for oneself without sharing.
meaning.zh: 好处独占，不肯与人分享。

examples.zh: 有了好项目，他从不吃独食，都带着大家一起做。
examples.en: With a good project, he never keeps it to himself and brings everyone along.

examples.zh: 好事都想吃独食，迟早会得罪人。
examples.en: If you want to hog every good thing, you will offend people sooner or later.

usage.en: Often negated: 不吃独食 is praise. Splits: 吃了独食.
usage.zh: 常用否定式“不吃独食”表示赞扬。

meaning.en: To lose one's job, one's source of living.
meaning.zh: 失去工作，断了生计。

examples.zh: 得罪了老板，他怕丢饭碗。
examples.en: Having offended the boss, he worried about losing his job.

examples.zh: 工厂倒闭，几百人丢了饭碗。
examples.en: The factory closed, and hundreds lost their livelihoods.

usage.en: 饭碗 is a livelihood; compare 铁饭碗 (a secure job).
usage.zh: “饭碗”指职业。可对照“铁饭碗”。

meaning.en: A difficult, prickly person who likes to make trouble or argue.
meaning.zh: 指爱挑刺、不好对付的人。

examples.zh: 班里有几个刺儿头，老师很头疼。
examples.en: There are a few troublemakers in the class, and the teacher has a headache.

examples.zh: 这个刺儿头总跟领导唱反调。
examples.en: This prickly character always goes against the leader.

usage.en: Northern colloquial. 儿 attaches to 刺; pinyin cì ér tóu.
usage.zh: 北方口语，儿化。

meaning.en: To shift responsibility from one person or office to another.
meaning.zh: 互相推卸责任。

examples.zh: 几个部门互相踢皮球，问题一直没解决。
examples.en: Several departments passed the buck and the problem was never solved.

examples.zh: 遇事别踢皮球，要主动担当。
examples.en: Don't pass the buck when something happens; take responsibility.

usage.en: Very common in news about bureaucracy. Often 互相踢皮球.
usage.zh: 常见于批评官僚作风的报道，常说“互相踢皮球”。

meaning.en: To talk in a roundabout way instead of getting to the point.
meaning.zh: 说话绕弯子，不直截了当。

examples.zh: 有话直说，别跟我打圈子。
examples.en: Speak plainly and don't beat around the bush with me.

examples.zh: 会议一直在打圈子，没有结论。
examples.en: The meeting kept going in circles with no conclusion.

usage.en: Also means moving round without progress. Opposite 开门见山.
usage.zh: 也可指原地绕转没有进展。反义“开门见山”。
